description: REQ-304's AKT funding-route correction (resolves FIND-402) and PROP-304d both cite '~/anicca/skills/self/spawn-child/config.json's own funding_route field' as specifying the FULL route, including a first 'Jupiter SOL→USDC (Solana, same-chain swap)' hop, followed by the Skip API 4-hop bridge. A fresh, direct read of the real config.json shows its funding_route field's literal string value is only 'solana/8453 -> noble-1 -> osmosis-1 -> akashnet-2 (Skip API smart_relay, 4-hop)' -- it does not mention Jupiter, SOL, or USDC anywhere, and its own first hop label 'solana/8453' conflates the Solana chain name with the literal string '8453' (which is Base's own EVM chain ID elsewhere in this same codebase, e.g. identity.mjs's IDENTITY_REGISTRY_BASE_MAINNET comment) -- an internally ambiguous label in the SOURCE file itself that the spec never flags or explains. The 'Jupiter SOL→USDC' step the spec attributes to config.json's field actually appears only as free-text prose in a DIFFERENT file, spawn-child/SKILL.md's own numbered list ('1. Jupiter: SOL → USDC (Solana) ... 2. Skip API 4-hop smart_relay ...'), which is not itself a machine-readable config field and is not cited anywhere in REQ-304/PROP-304d. The spec's phrasing over-attributes SKILL.md's prose to config.json's own field. The underlying multi-hop-route CONCLUSION (this is not a same-chain single-signer transfer) remains directionally correct and is the important part FIND-402 fixed, but the specific textual attribution 'config.json's own ... funding_route field specifies: Jupiter SOL→USDC ... THEN Skip API 4-hop ...' overstates what that one field literally contains, and the field's own 'solana/8453' ambiguity (does the route also support a Base-USDC source, given automaton's own wallet is Base-native?) is left unexamined even though it directly bears on whether automaton (not just Franklin) could ever independently fund an Akash deploy via this documented route.
